Vero Beach, FL 32960\nCourtroom:\n6\nPhone:\n(772) 226-3380\nJudicial Assistant:\nMaggie Molina\nEmail:\nMolinaM@circuit19.org\nBiography\nAssignment\n\nIndian River: All Juvenile Dependency and Delinquency Cases, including Detention and Shelter Hearings; All CINS/FINS Cases; Oversee Truancy court; All Probate and Guardianship Cases; All substance abuse and mental health court cases (i.e., Baker and Marchman Act cases); All Risk Protection Order Cases; All Jimmy Ryce Cases; Member of the Indian River County Children’s Services Council; Responsible for all post-conviction relief motions/hearings; Okeechobee County Early Childhood Court cases\n\nAdditional Information\nScheduling\n\nAttorneys may schedule Special Set Motions (1 hour or under) using the online scheduling program. Parties will be restricted to the time they allotted for the hearing. The calendar will indicate when the FAMILY or CIVIL UMC and Special Set Motion hearings are to be scheduled. Scheduling is done through the online scheduling calendar. Users must register to obtain a user id and password on the site. Copies of motions and notice of hearings must be sent to the Judicial Assistant. The Court reserves the discretion to reject any scheduling. Attorneys who repeatedly abuse the online scheduling may be denied further privileges of self-scheduling. Non-evidentiary motions may be denied without hearing, e.g., motions to dismiss.  Please review Judge White’s procedures posted on here as well.\n\nLonger hearings must be set with the Judicial Assistant after sending a copy to the Judicial Assistant. Attorneys should consult the Judge’s on-line calendar (link below) and confer with opposing counsel on mutually convenient dates before calling the J.A.\n\nImportant: If you schedule a case for a special set hearing and that hearing is canceled, a notice of cancellation must be filed (and a copy emailed to Judge White’s Judicial Assistant: MolinaM@circuit19.org). If the hearing is canceled on the online scheduling calendar, and a last-minute cancellation is being made, you must contact Judge White’s Judicial Assistant immediately.\n\nProcedures\n\nProcedures\n\nProbate Memo (PDF)\n\nZoom Memo (PDF)\n\nCalendars\n\nOnline Scheduling Calendar\n\nForms\nGuardianship\n\nAnnual Accounting Form (PDF)\n\nAnnual Audit Checklist (PDF)\n\nAnnual Investigation Form (PDF)\n\nAnnual Plan Form (PDF)\n\nApplication for Appointment (PDF)\n\nAuthorization of Payment to Attorney (PDF)\n\nAuthorization of Payment to Guardian (PDF)\n\nInitial Inventory Form (PDF)\n\nInitial Plan Form (PDF)\n\nSimplified Accounting Form (PDF)\n\nIncapacity\n\nOrder Appointing Attorney (PDF)\n\nOrder Appointing Examining Committee (PDF)\n\nOrder Determining Incapacity (PDF)\n\nOrder for Compensation of Examining Committee (PDF)\n\nPetition to Determining Incapacity (PDF)\n\nProbate\n\nSummary Administration Checklist (PDF)\n\nClose Formal Administration Checklist (PDF)\n\nDisposition of Personal Property Checklist (PDF)\n\nOpen Formal Administration Checklist (PDF)\n\nAffidavit of Heirs (PDF)\n\nProbate Memorandum (PDF)\n\nE Filing Portal\nThe Nineteenth Judicial Circuit\n\nThe Nineteenth Judicial Circuit serves the Indian River, Martin, St. Lucie, and Okeechobee counties.
